import json,sys,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
cfg=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
root=Path("docs/course-revision-20261016/reader-sessions")
target=Path(cfg["base"])/"reader-original-01.json"
if target.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Report already exists; refusing to overwrite.")
def sha(path):
    result=subprocess.run(["shasum","-a","256",str(path)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    return result.stdout.split()[0]
def part(answer):
    match=re.search(r"判定[：:]\s*(已足夠|需補說明|合理待教|未驗證)",answer)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("A concept answer has no explicit verdict.")
    return {"answer":answer[:match.start()].strip(),"verdict":match.group(1)}
freeze_path="docs/course-review-20261019/freeze-01.json"
plan_path="docs/course-review-20261019/reader-plan-ch01-02.json"
report={
"schema_version":1,
"reviewer_task":cfg["reviewer"],
"created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"report_kind":"original first-read judgments after sequential reading",
"source_freeze":{"path":freeze_path,"sha256":sha(freeze_path)},
"reading_plan":{"path":plan_path,"sha256":sha(plan_path)},
"context_reading":"先透過reader.py完整補讀first-steps。實際用到W.2的0起算索引、清單/字典、切片、set/sorted、enumerate、zip、生成式、join、函式、迴圈及assert；W.3的tensor形狀、軸、dim與負軸、索引、item/tolist及跨軸計算，並看了兩人三考平均圖；W.4的機率總和、e次方、自然log、正確答案負log及cross_entropy輸入約定；W.5的nn工具箱名稱；W.6的旋鈕、平方代價、導數/梯度、backward只求導、no_grad更新、學習率與局部限制，並看了w1到1.4的曲線圖。W.1提供網站輸出及Notebook工作桌狀態的閱讀方式，W.7提供KeyError等錯誤意思。沒有執行教材程式或開啟外部連結。正文含CPU輸出共55個單元依序保存後，才補讀各頁折疊選讀；本報告未驗證網站桌機/手機排版、實作檔案、連結實驗紀錄或重新跑實驗。服務滿載中斷後從既有1.7當前單元續讀，沒有重做或修改已存筆記。",
"method_incidents":[],
"pages":[]
}
for session,p in zip(cfg["sessions"],cfg["pages"],strict=True):
    folder=root/session
    opening_path=folder/"opening.json"
    opening=json.loads(opening_path.read_text())
    assert opening["page_id"]==p["page"]
    assert opening["reviewer_task"]==cfg["reviewer"]
    assert opening["source_freeze"]==report["source_freeze"]
    assert opening["reading_plan"]==report["reading_plan"]
    paths=sorted(folder.glob("note-*.json"))
    state=json.loads((folder/"state.json").read_text())
    assert state["next_index"]==len(paths)
    notes={}
    for i,path in enumerate(paths):
        n=json.loads(path.read_text())
        assert n["unit_index"]==i
        assert n["reviewer_task"]==cfg["reviewer"]
        notes[i]=n
    checks=[]
    for unit,j in p["select"]:
        c=notes[unit]["concept_checks"][j]
        checks.append({
            "concept":c["concept"],
            "identity":c["identity"],
            "mechanism":part(c["mechanism"]),
            "need":part(c["need"]),
            "usage":c["usage"],
            "example_scope":c["example_scope"],
            "source_quote":c["source_quote"],
            "verdict":c["verdict"]
        })
    figures=[]
    if p["page"] in cfg["figures"]:
        f=cfg["figures"][p["page"]]
        assert sha(f["svg"])==f["hash"]
        assert f["hash"] in opening["figures_sha256"].values()
        figures.append({
            "svg":f["svg"],
            "png":"outputs/course-review-20261019/figure-renders/"+f["hash"]+".png",
            "observation":f["observation"]
        })
    report["pages"].append({
        "page_id":p["page"],
        "source_sha256":opening["source_sha256"],
        "figures_sha256":opening["figures_sha256"],
        "verdict":"pass",
        "reader_summary":p["summary"],
        "checks":checks,
        "issues":[],
        "unknowns":p["unknowns"],
        "missing_visuals":p["visual"]+"本次只看指定PNG及reader文字，未驗證實際網站圖文相鄰性與桌機/手機版面。",
        "figures_viewed":figures,
        "optional_reading_observation":p["optional"],
        "ai_estimate":{"minutes_min":p["minutes"][0],"minutes_max":p["minutes"][1],"reason":"AI估計，非真人計時；"+p["reason"]+"不含首次安裝環境耗時。"},
        "session":session,
        "session_evidence":{
            "opening":{"path":str(opening_path),"sha256":sha(opening_path)},
            "notes":[{"path":str(n),"sha256":sha(n)} for n in paths]
        }
    })
assert len(report["pages"])==16
target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with target.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"path":str(target),"sha256":sha(target),"pages":len(report["pages"]),"notes":sum(len(p["session_evidence"]["notes"]) for p in report["pages"]),"checks":sum(len(p["checks"]) for p in report["pages"]),"necessary_issues":0},ensure_ascii=False))
